svg.aria-label: Drawing CLR-HW-101: CLEAR MOUNT · BOSS AND SOCKET
svg.text: 1. PRINT BOSS AS PART OF EACH BACK SHELL; SOCKET AS PART OF EACH ADD-ON.
2. MAGNETS: N52 DISC Ø10 × 3, 4 PER SIDE, OPPOSITE POLES. PRESS FIT, DROP OF CA GLUE.
3. BAYONET: INSERT AT NOTCHES, TURN 35° TO SEAT MAGNETS. DETENT FROM MAGNETS.
4. PETG OR ASA, 0.2 LAYER, 4 WALLS, 40% GYROID. PRINT SOCKET FACE UP.
5. GENERAL TOLERANCE ±0.2. PRINT FIT COUPON BEFORE FULL PARTS.
6. SAME BOSS, SAME POSITION FROM CENTRE, ON ALL THREE SHELLS.
HIDDEN LINES SHOW LIP AND GROOVE
